title: What must the reason 41 request contain (DBVO, Vorerkrankungszeiten)?

fields.name: ABGABEGRUND
fields.meaning: Reason code of the message: always 41 for this request.

fields.name: AU-AB-AG
fields.meaning: Start of the current sick period, as known to the employer.

sources.quote: [PLACEHOLDER § 3.12] field for the start of the current incapacity at the employer

fields.name: ANZAHL-AU
fields.meaning: Number of earlier sick periods reported in this block.

fields.name: BEGINN-AU-n
fields.meaning: Start of the n-th reported earlier sick period (n = 1 is the newest).

sources.quote: [PLACEHOLDER § 3.12] start date of a reported period

fields.name: ENDE-AU-n
fields.meaning: End of the n-th reported earlier sick period (n = 1 is the newest).

sources.quote: [PLACEHOLDER § 3.12] end date of a reported period

rules.meaning: Content is only produced when the message must be sent at all (level 1 = yes).

sources.quote: [PLACEHOLDER p.135] the request may only be made when its conditions are met

rules.meaning: Only earlier sick periods with a sick note count; a short absence without one is not a previous illness.

sources.quote: [PLACEHOLDER p.135] absence without a sick note is not a potential previous illness

rules.meaning: Go back from the current period through earlier ones while the free time between two illnesses stays within this many months; stop at the first longer gap.
Whether a free time of exactly gap_months still continues the chain. The two pages disagree.

sources.quote: [PLACEHOLDER p.135] nicht mehr als 6 Monate (exactly 6 months still counts)
[PLACEHOLDER p.136] nicht mindestens 6 Monate (exactly 6 months ends the chain)

rules.meaning: How far back periods may be reported, in months before the current period; null = no limit. The two pages disagree.

sources.quote: [PLACEHOLDER p.135] hierfür gilt keine zeitliche Begrenzung
[PLACEHOLDER p.136] jedoch maximal innerhalb der letzten 12 Monate
